feeds.title: Zoomer
feeds.description: Everything Zoomer is a 'Baby Boomer with Zip'. It is the lifestyle site for the discriminating, with features ranging from food & entertaining, style & fashion, arts & entertainment, sex & relating, health, finance, travel and spirit.

feeds.title: Sixty and Me » Fashion
feeds.description: Fashion for women over 60 is about finding the perfect balance between looking and feeling your best. Let's help each other to find the best dresses, shoes, jeans and more for women our age.

feeds.title: Life Part 2 & Beyond Blog
feeds.description: In 2011 Jonathan Look sold everything he owned, took early retirement and began travelling the world. He started this blog to demonstrate to his fellow baby boomers that the world is not some scary place and it is still open and available to those who are motivated and curious enough to go out and see it for themselves.

feeds.title: The GypsyNesters
feeds.description: David & Veronica are experiencing the collision of Baby Boomer and Empty Nester. David and Veronica James chose to look at this next phase of life as a beginning instead of an ending. Most importantly, they rediscover in themselves the fun-loving youngsters who fell in love three decades prior.

feeds.title: Contented Traveller
feeds.description: Paula and Gordon of Contented Traveller, are Destination & Experience Marketers. This is a travel blog sharing how to get the best experiences when you travel; because you have worked hard and you've earned it.

feeds.title: Travel Notes & Beyond Blog
feeds.description: Information about beautiful vacation spots, good eats, and interesting places around the world written by Anda Galffy. Anda is an Award-winning travel writer and passionate photographer based in Southern California.

feeds.title: Baby Boomster
feeds.description: I'm Rebecca Olkowski, a Los Angeles-based Baby Boomer, and my blog Baby Boomster focuses on active older women who are not ready for a rocking chair but are ready to rock! They enjoy life, love to travel, look good, feel well, and are not afraid to reinvent themselves to live better lives no matter what their circumstances.

feeds.title: Clark Norton
feeds.description: Clark has chronicled the baby boom generation since the days he and many of his contemporaries were backpacking around Europe. Clark knows what attracts baby boomers to travel and make the most of it.

feeds.title: Cresting The Hill
feeds.description: A blog that celebrates Midlife because the best is yet to come. This is where I write about how great Midlife is. I'm a huge fan of the empty nest, and I love where I am in life at this moment in time. I share the lessons I've learned and my journey towards this point - because I want everyone to find the happiness that I'm experiencing

feeds.title: My Itchy Travel Feet
feeds.description: At My Itchy Travel Feet, baby boomers will find inspiration and advice to help plan their next adventure. Baby boomers Donna L. Hull and Alan Hull travel the world recording their experiences with words, photos and videos so that you'll know exactly what to expect.

feeds.title: Honey Good
feeds.description: Welcome to Honey Good—where women over 50 reclaim joy, confidence, and connection. Whether you're navigating estrangement, rediscovering self-care, or writing your next chapter, this is your space to feel seen, supported, and inspired. Let's flourish—together.

feeds.title: Boomer Magazine
feeds.description: Boomer Magazine is Richmond's premier lifestyle magazine that engages readers with informative and entertaining articles on nostalgia, food, drink, travel, arts, entertainment, home, health, family and much more.

feeds.title: Hole In The Donut Blog
feeds.description: My name is Barbara Weibel and I'm the person behind Hole in the Donut Cultural Travel. My mission is to Long-term travel to learn about other cultures and bring this information to readers through narrative articles on my travel blog.

feeds.title: The Roaming Boomers Blog
feeds.description: We are a Online luxury travel magazine offering destination information, travel news, travel gadget reviews, and more. All delivered with stunning photography and informative videos. Our mission is to inspire you to get out there and explore the wonders of our world.

feeds.title: To Travel Too Blog
feeds.description: Baby Boomers is a travel blog for aspiring travelers. Here they share our Baby Boomer travel experiences, thoughts, aspirations, and intentions as we travel. Jane and Duncan in their travel blog, talk about Global travel guides, hotel reviews, travel tips and tricks, transport, tours, and more.

feeds.title: Made You Smile Back Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to Baby Boomers as they smile back as life progresses.

feeds.title: A Labour of Life
feeds.description: A Labour of Life is my view of the world from a Boomer's perspective. Life begins at 50, a time where travel, food, wine, and fashion merge together guilt-free.

feeds.title: Creating Results Blog
feeds.description: Creating Results helps organizations increase sales from Baby Boomers and seniors through integrated, strategic marketing. Creating Results partners with clients in senior living, healthcare, travel, financial services, real estate and more to motivate Baby Boomers and Seniors.

feeds.title: What Boundaries? Live Your Dream!
feeds.description: Enjoy the adventures of Cheryl and Lisa as they travel the world and share great travel tips and destination information. Learn how you can Live YOUR dream!

feeds.title: Luggage and Lipstick Blog
feeds.description: I am a Baby Boomer. Not a senior yet, but definitely in mid-life and loving it. And Luggage and Lipstick is my boomer travel blog with loads of tips.

feeds.title: A Baby Boomer Woman's Life After 50
feeds.description: Boomergirl's blog is targeted to baby boomer women. It shares how to transform your life after 50, including reinventing retirement, post 50 travel, wellness and beauty tips for aging gracefully, and surviving widowhood. I'm a 60+ boomer blogger and #yoga teacher. My goal as I age is to keep my chin up so my neck stays forever wrinkle-free.

feeds.title: Traveling with Sweeney
feeds.description: Catherine Sweeney brings you the best of Europe and North America travel destinations by seizing every travel opportunity she can. She's a boomer woman travel enthusiast with a lifelong passion for going places.

feeds.title: 50 Shades of Age
feeds.description: HI I am Kathy.I decided to start up 50 Shades Of Age, a website where I could reach out to my sisters and tell them that their lives could be so much more. I wanted to be the voice for the new-age over 50 years old to empower and motivate them to feel worthy again! We have so much to offer.

feeds.title: National Association of Baby Boomer Women
feeds.description: The National Association of Baby Boomer Women (NABBW) is a United States-based membership organization primarily focused on serving Baby Boomer Women. Through our programs, benefits, communications and services, the NABBW is passionately dedicated to uniting, supporting, advocating for and educating Baby Boomer Women living in North America and throughout the world.

feeds.title: The Aging Female Baby Boomer
feeds.description: A blog written by a retired woman who is just trying to figure things out.

feeds.title: Green With Renvy
feeds.description: Baby Boomer and founder Alison Abbott has been a multi discipline designer for all of her adult life. She is a serious adventurer, content creator and small business strategist, who is enthusiastic about keeping it local whether at home or abroad. Alison shares the experience of eco-friendly travel and lifestyle through Green With Renvy.

feeds.title: Travel Past 50 Blog
feeds.description: We're Kristin Henning and Tom Bartel. In 2010, we sold our business, our home, our possessions, and gave away our dog.We've been traveling the world ever since. Travel Past 50 offers encouragement, entertainment, and information, with sharp writing, personal tales, and professional photography, for travelers over the age of 50.

feeds.title: Barbara Falconer Newhall Blog
feeds.description: Riffs on life from a veteran journalist Barbara Falconer Newhall.

feeds.title: John Tarnoff
feeds.description: John Tarnoff provides career coaching to help you create your dream career over 50 and earn income beyond traditional retirement.

feeds.title: Travel Younger Blog
feeds.description: This blog is committed to inspiring and showing you how to travel more affordably, with less stress, and more adventure, especially for the so-called older demographics! We can learn much from the younger crowd who travel with more ease and more adven.

feeds.title: Boomer Broadcast
feeds.description: BOOMERBROADcast is my platform for being the voice of Baby Boomers, women in particular. Baby Boomer's social commentary on life in OUR sixties for those who rocked life in THE sixties.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Lola
feeds.description: Baby Boomer Lola - still growing, still learning, not too old, pinches wiser, with youth in the heart.

feeds.title: BoomSpeak
feeds.description: BoomSpeak offers original content that is for baby boomers and by baby boomers. It's a website that appeals to the interests and changing priorities of baby boomers, including travel, culture, fiction, and personal essays. BoomSpeak is about possibilities and the vital and energizing things you can do with the rest of your life.

feeds.title: Boomers
feeds.description: Brent Green, author of books and articles about Baby Boomers and business, explores how 'Generation Reinvention' today is changing business, marketing, aging and the future. A Trip Into the Heart of the Baby Boomer Generation he covers Commentary about Media, Marketing, Advertising, Sociology, Culture, Politics, Aging, and the Future.

feeds.title: Legging It
feeds.description: We are Ron and Michele, an Australian couple from Perth who have decided not to wait until we retire to travel the world but get out there and embrace life while we are still young. We hope our blog inspires you to step out of your comfort zone and do something different to live the life you love be it travel, study, work or your relationships.

feeds.title: Writer To Writer
feeds.description: Covers rants, raves, joys and regrets, blocks and breakthroughs as Victoria writes her book and you write yours, and we all find the courage to keep on telling the truth.

feeds.title: FabOverFifty
feeds.description: When I was born on March 8, 1947, I was one of the first babies who were later designated 'boomers.' I wanted to create a website where our dynamic generation of women could share our singular style, exceptional experiences, and brilliant recommendations. FabOverFifty is the world's first website for smart, stylish, successful women over 50.

feeds.title: Career Pivot Blog
feeds.description: Covers blog topics such as career change, job search, networking, career success, personal branding, entrepreneurship, social media and more. Founder Marc Miller is a career designer and he is passionate about his work and the clients he serves. He has taught in more than 35 countries and helped clients from many industries. Career Pivot is a career design firm for baby boomers like you who want a change, but know you can't just leap from one life to another.

feeds.title: BoomerStartingOver
feeds.description: Seriously, what can really be said about a late generational boomer rapidly approaching his 60's that hasn't already been said on any other blog, website, facebook post, tweet or magazine article? Probably nothing, except none of those were about me and my own life experiences.

feeds.title: Throomers
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Throomers.

feeds.title: Yesterday | A Baby Boomers Rite of Passage
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from a Baby Boomers Rite of Passage

feeds.title: Changing Aging
feeds.description: Changing Aging is a multi-blog platform challenging conventional views on aging. They believe aging is a strength, rich in developmental potential and growth.

feeds.title: Sightings Over Sixty
feeds.description: A blog by A Baby Boomer who looks at health, finance, retirement, grown-up children and ... how time flies. Covers topics such as Boomernomics, Children, Investing Strategies, Health, Living Arrangements, Planning for Retirement, Retirement Activities, Travel and more.

feeds.title: Grandma's Briefs
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa. I'm a grandma, a mom, a wife. I write on the good, bad, humorous and heartwarming of being a baby boomer, grandparent, parent to adult children, wife and writer.

feeds.title: Until the next time . . .
feeds.description: Until the next time... is a blog usually focused on writing, music, and travel to places near and far. It concerns some of the things I've learned and some of the things I've messed up through the years. The blog also appears at www.michaelembry.com/blog.html.

feeds.title: Mamal Diane
feeds.description: I'm a mamal (grandma) blogger who loves talking about her grandkids, dogs, traveling, Disney, food recipes and keeping my life simple. I am pursuing a life of simplicity and self sufficiency. I enjoy cooking, gardening, sharing ideas and spending time with my grand children. I also love giveaways and contests. Blog by Diane.

feeds.title: Travels With Carole
feeds.description: Travel the world with travel writer and blogger Carole Terwilliger Meyers. This travel blog uses short descriptions with plenty of images.

feeds.title: L' FAIR QUILTS
feeds.description: Welcome to L Fair Quilts! I am a wife, mom, quilter and pattern designer for Black Cat Creations. Following a 41-year career with local government, retirement has now afforded me time for new quilting adventures. Much to my surprise, the transition has been easy.

feeds.title: Sensational Baby Boomers
feeds.description: Both called Anne, we have been friends for more than 40 years. We created this site because we firmly believe that our 60s are our new 40s - we still love fashion and style, relish clothes shopping, adore travelling and enjoy feeling good for our ages.

feeds.title: BloomerBoomer.com
feeds.description: For baby boomers and people over 50. Baby boomers are set to perform another transformative feat in the fashion that defined them from the beginning.A lifestyle website, focusing on diet, vitality, wellbeing, brain health, exercise, and second careers.

feeds.title: Rock The Wrinkle
feeds.description: Rock The Wrinkle is for everyone 50 who wants to start over, recharge, retire, keep working, be healthy and get the most out of life! Fun, facts and things boomer. Really enjoy your 50 life!

feeds.title: An Empowered Spirit Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cathy Chester and my blog will empower you to live a healthy and vibrant life after 50. So let's talk about ability, gratitude, paying it forward, animal rights, books, films, and maintaining good health. I want to help you create a life that's filled with passion, purpose and a whole lot of laughter.

feeds.title: Boomerrantz
feeds.description: Hi, I am Pat. Welcome to my blog, a place where I can write, rant and rave into the blogosphere about the adventures and misadventures of everyday life. My mission here with boomerrantz is to express some ageing boomer opinions about how I perceive the world around me, in all its glory and carbuncles.

feeds.title: Not Dun Roamin
feeds.description: Travel blog with ideas, information & reviews for the older, active traveller - from Australia to Zululand!

feeds.title: Boomer Music Update
feeds.description: A weekly catch-up for Boomers who want to keep in touch with today's music. We connect a song from back-in-the-day to a current hit that has a similar sound/content/style.

feeds.title: Dear Jessica Brennan Blog
feeds.description: Sometimes poignant, often witty letters written to my daughter. Come on in and see what projects Jessica and I have on the go. Spoiler Alert: Having me for a mum isn't always easy!

feeds.title: Boomer Out
feeds.description: Baby boomers are aging and beginning to leave the scene (finally, you say). What shaped us as a generation, and what impact did we have on the world? These and other questions about us will provide the grist for this blog.

feeds.title: Dear Baby Boomer....
feeds.description: Memories of simpler times growing up in the 50's and 60's filled my thoughts and my 'Dear Babyboomer' blog was born. And..through illustrating many of my posts my 'Dear Babyboomer' card series was born. I hope to introduce them here. I hope you will enjoy my memories and will feel free to share some of your own!

feeds.title: Stilettos Not Required
feeds.description: Stilettos Not Required is a blog about life of a baby boomer.

feeds.title: Southeastern Bound
feeds.description: Two Boomers travel the USA looking for realistic, low-cost places in interesting and historic places. The have traveled from the Atlantic to the Pacific finding hidden, less-known sites that inspire stories and pictures.

feeds.title: BOOMER WORLD
feeds.description: Find all things baby boomer on Boomer World Blog.

feeds.title: A Boomer's Memories
feeds.description: A Boomer's Memories is a happy collection of short pieces about growing up a as a part of America's biggest generation and a view of life from a Baby Boomer's perspective.

feeds.title: The Baby Bloomer Blog
feeds.description: The Baby Boomer is a place for women who travel or who dream of traveling. We share funny and inspiring stories, ideas for solo/friend/group travel, advice about where to go, and reminiscences for Boomer women and those who love them.

feeds.title: Aging Like a Fine Wine
feeds.description: Welcome to Aging Like a Fine Wine. My name is Teresa and I'm a baby boomer, wife, mother and grandparent. I blog about all things relevant to the second half of life.

feeds.title: Possess The World
feeds.description: We are Cath and Ian, an Aussie couple who love food, wine and travelling. Over the last 5 years we have traveled together, starting with a few weeks at a time until 2017 when we are travelling for 12 months. This is our travel blog to inspire you to take up travelling independently. Subscribe us for tips and tales from our travels to help and inspire you to Possess the World.

feeds.title: The Baby Boomer Entrepreneur
feeds.description: Andrea Stenberg, The Baby Boomer Entrepreneur helps business owners, consultants and entrepreneurs get new clients with social media.

feeds.title: Boomeresque
feeds.description: Boomeresque is a forum for posts and discussions about Baby Boomer Travels for the Body and Mind.

feeds.title: Digital Savvy Granny
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Ruth Coetzee and I am just an ordinary 50 something granny that loves reading, my electronic devices and expanding my knowledge in many diverse fields. I have an insatiable curiosity, a bucket list that is a mile long, enjoy spending time with family and friends and every now and then 'pushes the envelope' by doing things that society says I cannot do. 'Says Who?'

feeds.title: Hybrid Boomer
feeds.description: Have you recently transitioned to working from home? Welcome to Hybrid Boomer, an online blog dedicated to helping and entertaining baby boomers who've just shifted from office work to working from home.

feeds.title: Dare2go
feeds.description: dare2go is the overland travel blog, written with regular tourists & overlanders in mind. We share our life on the road, beautiful photos, and advice from our experiences.

feeds.title: A Good Goodbye
feeds.description: Gail Rubin, author, speaker, journalist and death educator, connects with Baby Boomers using humour, funny films and a light touch on serious subjects. At A Good Goodbye, we bring light to a dark subject, providing the information, inspiration, and tools to plan a meaningful, memorable end-of-life event.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Resistance
feeds.description: We cover commentary on policies that Democrats oppose, strategies and solutions suggested to constructively resist Trump and his authoritarianism, written by a psychotherapist with decades of experience. Baby Boomer Resistance Blog is staunchly Anti-Trump Administration.

feeds.title: Center for Retirement Research Blog » Baby Boomer
feeds.description: This blog is for practitioners in the field of financial literacy, including financial advisers, employers, government and foundation officials, and researchers. Squared Away will cover anything that might help them do a better job of helping Americans of all ages act in their own financial best interest and help them get their all-important financial matters 'squared away.'

feeds.title: Elaine Ambrose Blog
feeds.description: Elaine is an award-winning author, syndicated blogger, speaker and retreat organizer. Elaine professes that laughter with wine is the best medicine and continues to entertain her audiences in her blog.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Bliss
feeds.description: Julie Gorges, a baby boomer herself, has been writing professionally for more than 20 years. She writes about baby boomer humor, grandparenting, happiness tips, health, menopausal musings, retirement, travel and leisure on her blog.

feeds.title: Solo Travel Girl Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Jennifer Huber, and I am just your average forty-something-year-old gal who travels solo. Empowering others to travel alone, not lonely.

feeds.title: SeniorResource
feeds.description: Our mission is to connect with the Baby Boomer generation. This blog and website are dedicated to all people over 50 years of age, their golden years and have begun thinking seriously about living comfortably and actively in retirement. Best baby boomer places to live, find jobs, sites, travel, best movies, entertain, find retirement communities, boomer blogs and live the great boomers life.

feeds.title: Next Avenue
feeds.description: Find news, advice, information, conversations and stories curated for people over 50 on Next Avenue. We are the only national public media journalism service for baby boomers and seniors.

feeds.title: Baby Boomers
feeds.description: Babyboomers is a brand new online news and lifestyle destination for all things Baby Boomers. We aim to empower Boomers to lead a more extraordinary life by connecting them with the people, culture and ideas that really matter to them. Anytime. Anywhere.

feeds.title: Baby to Boomer Lifestyle
feeds.description: We are a family of moms and dads, singles and married couples, parents and childless-by-choice, and all ages. This is a lifestyle, travel & review blog from Seattle, specializing in parenting, technology, cooking, crafts, travel, and more.

feeds.title: The Survive and Thrive Boomer Guide
feeds.description: Rita Robison Shares information to help baby boomers make smart consumer choices.

feeds.title: Time Goes By | What it's really like to get old
feeds.description: Time Goes By covers a variety of topics - from retirement, age discrimination and ageism, media, health, love and sex, culture, technology and more. Many writers contribute to this blog, allowing for a variety of perspectives and expertise.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Retirement
feeds.description: Find the hundreds of useful articles on financial planning, Social Security, Medicare, where to retire, medical issues and travel. It is an award winning retirement blog where baby boomers share their retirement dreams and challenges.

feeds.title: Boomer Buyer Guides
feeds.description: Boomer Buyer Guides covers topics that are important to Baby Boomers including money and health as well as reviews on product and services Boomers use.

feeds.title: Any Shiny Thing Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to AnyShinyThing, where aging and feminism intersect. I write about breaking set norms for women and managing midlife. Published my first novel at 58. I write midlife fiction.

feeds.title: Retirement for Baby Boomers
feeds.description: With ages ranging from about 54 to about 73 (born somewhere between 1945 to 1964), many of us in the baby-boom generation have already retired or will be retiring soon. This blog is designed to help them. This blog will focus primarily on four areas: Finances, Health, Location, and Activities and Relationships. Whether you're already retired, still in the thinking-about-it stage, or convinced you never will, this blog will provide a wealth of resources to inform your decisions.

feeds.title: Born to Be Boomers
feeds.description: My purpose of starting this site is to share our life experiences with you! I am recently retired and our passion is travel and food but this site will also include insights on family, health and general information about life over 50. Our wish is to be able to share our growing family, growing pains and lot of great times with you.

feeds.title: Retirement Voices Blog
feeds.description: Retirement Voices explores the immense human impact of retirement on the identity and sense of purpose, relationships, health and everyday life. Retirement Voices is a community of women helping women navigate retirement.

feeds.title: next for me
feeds.description: next for me publishes news and resources for 50+ generation.

feeds.title: 60 is the New 50
feeds.description: 60isthenew50.com covers a broad range of topics including travel, men's fashion and skincare, women's fashion and beauty tips, health and fitness, retirement, downsizing, and more. We will refer you to a number of web sites that provide very useful information in the various topics covered and be an information catch-all for the broad spectrum 50 generation.

feeds.title: Tracey Barnes Priestley in the Second Half
feeds.description: Tracey Barnes Priestley enjoys a career as both a writer and life coach. Tracey is launching The Boomer Troupe, an ensemble of writers and performers, all over fifty, who will perform variety shows in small theaters, schools, and senior facilities.

feeds.title: Istoryya | Life is meant for sharing
feeds.description: Storytelling is a powerful way for us to inspire each other. So, I started with my own story to remind girls and women that marrying young, for whatever reason and circumstance, cannot stop them from achieving their dreams. I am a humanitarian worker for over 15 years covering parts of Asia, the Middle East and Africa and have heard amazing stories from the front line.

feeds.title: Roommates 4 Boomers
feeds.description: Hi. My name is Karen Venable, founder of Roommates4Boomers. I am one of a growing group of women baby boomers entering a new phase of life. Roommates4boomers connects women boomers of similar lifestyle. backgrounds and interests who are searching for a roommate to share the comforts of home and friendship.

feeds.title: boomerwatch
feeds.description: boomerwatch is a blog by Lina Ko providing Canadian and North American insights on marketing to baby boomers. boomerwatch blog has been serving as a forum where users can access all kinds of relevant information on the baby-boomer audience.

feeds.title: Booming Encore
feeds.description: Welcome to Booming Encore - we're so glad you are here and hope that we can help you make every day matter. Our motto is every day matters and to support this we try to provide you valuable, thoughtful information that matters to you. We share information on health, careers, finances and travel.

feeds.title: Boomer Health Institute
feeds.description: The Boomer Health Institute shares secrets with the baby boomer population so that they can lead a less stressed, more balanced, and more meaningful life.
